
Machin Shin is the entity that roams the ways, corrupting all those that it comes into contact with and ultimately driving those people insane.&nbsp; I've read the theories about how Machin Shin was created yet there remains one theory that nobody has seem to mention.&nbsp; Aridhol.&nbsp; Aridhol had a waygate and when Aridhol became corrupted and fell another entity was created.&nbsp; Mashadar.&nbsp; Now during the trolloc wars the ways became corrupted with the entity known as Machin Shin but it was never explained if that perhaps a part of Mashadar had seeped into the ways through the waygate in Aridhol.&nbsp; It could have been possible that trollocs or an army of the darkone were seeking refuge of the ways from Mashadar and in the process a part of Mashadar was trapped inside the ways, unable to escape the piece evolved and became something else.&nbsp;
